mapper.sql: r.*, stu.real_name as studentName, stu.user_no as studentNo, tea.real_name as teacherName, l.lab_name as labName, d.department_name as departmentName
mapper.select: select from lab_experiment_report r join sys_user stu on stu.id = r.student_id join sys_user tea on tea.id = r.teacher_id join department d on d.id = r.department_id left join lab l on l.id = r.lab_id where r.id = #{id} and r.deleted = 0
select * from lab_experiment_report_consumable where report_id = #{reportId} order by id asc
mapper.sql: rc.*, r.report_no as reportNo, r.experiment_name as experimentName, r.status as reportStatus, r.submitted_at as submittedAt, stu.real_name as studentName, tea.real_name as teacherName, l.lab_name as labName, confirmer.real_name as confirmUserName
mapper.select: select from lab_experiment_report_consumable rc join lab_experiment_report r on r.id = rc.report_id join sys_user stu on stu.id = r.student_id join sys_user tea on tea.id = r.teacher_id join lab l on l.id = rc.lab_id left join sys_user confirmer on confirmer.id = rc.confirm_user_id where rc.id = #{id} and r.deleted = 0
select count(*) from lab_experiment_report_consumable where report_id = #{reportId} and status = 2
mapper.insert: insert into lab_experiment_report( report_no, student_id, teacher_id, department_id, lab_id, reservation_id, title, experiment_name, experiment_date, purpose, principle, steps, result_data, analysis, conclusion, status, teacher_comment, deleted ) values( #{reportNo}, #{studentId}, #{teacherId}, #{departmentId}, #{labId}, #{reservationId}, #{title}, #{experimentName}, #{experimentDate}, #{purpose}, #{principle}, #{steps}, #{resultData}, #{analysis}, #{conclusion}, #{status}, #{teacherComment}, 0 )
mapper.update: update lab_experiment_report set teacher_id = #{teacherId}, lab_id = #{labId}, reservation_id = #{reservationId}, title = #{title}, experiment_name = #{experimentName}, experiment_date = #{experimentDate}, purpose = #{purpose}, principle = #{principle}, steps = #{steps}, result_data = #{resultData}, analysis = #{analysis}, conclusion = #{conclusion}, status = #{status}, teacher_comment = #{teacherComment}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt} where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
update lab_experiment_report set status = 2, submitted_at = now(), reviewed_at = null where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
update lab_experiment_report set status = #{status}, teacher_comment = #{teacherComment}, reviewed_at = now() where id = #{id} and teacher_id = #{teacherId} and deleted = 0
update lab_experiment_report_consumable set status = 2, confirm_user_id = #{confirmUserId}, confirmed_at = now(), stock_log_id = #{stockLogId}, reject_reason = null where id = #{id} and status = 1
update lab_experiment_report_consumable set status = 3, confirm_user_id = #{confirmUserId}, confirmed_at = now(), reject_reason = #{rejectReason} where id = #{id} and status = 1
